direct_arm_comparison_scope: Alone and mixed percentages use LP-only and SB-only references; subtraction requires an assumed reference conversion and is not an uncalibrated current contrast.

source_normalization.mixed_reference: SB-only WT cell line; the alone arm uses LP-only WT
source_normalization.source: O'Neill et al. 2022, Data Analysis; doi:10.1016/j.gim.2022.02.010
source_normalization.power_law_equivalence: 100*0.5**log2(W/100)=100**2/W; identical floor by construction, not an independent scenario or corroboration
source_normalization.replication_unit: cells treated as independent; 27–164 per mixed variant; transfections, plates and days not reported
limits: The inferred fraction assumes linear current versus assembly-competent abundance and unchanged WT function.
The equal-dose 50% floor is an additive calibration sensitivity; an unknown nonlinear response function does not identify a floor.
The power-law floor equals the linear control floor algebraically and supplies no independent corroboration.

Treating p.Trp822Ter as inert uses its134.2% mixed response as a WT contribution proxy; the source reports4.7% current alone and suggests a poorly conducting multimer. Its biological validity is unresolved.
The normalized SB reference is treated as fixed; shared-reference/batch covariance is unavailable.

falconer.convention: x = phi_WT - phi_hom = 2a; y = phi_WT - phi_het = a - d

discrepancy_interpretation: analyst-chosen Gaussian SDs; not an estimated floor-error distribution

fraction_sensitivity.interpretation: assumed mutant fraction in the assembly-competent pool; analyst-chosen grid, not an estimate of p

tipping_definitions.p_point_estimate_rescue: fraction at which the floor equals the measured mixed current
tipping_definitions.p_significance_rescue: largest assumed fraction at which the Bonferroni-adjusted test still rejects
tipping_definitions.tau_star_propagated_two_sided: Gaussian discrepancy SD (percentage points) at which the propagated two-sided test stops rejecting, p = 0.5
tipping_definitions.tau_star_log_ratio: discrepancy SD (percentage points at the floor, entering the log scale as tau/floor) at which the log-ratio test stops rejecting, p = 0.5
tipping_definitions.nu_star_log_ratio: smallest effective degrees of freedom at which the log-ratio statistic still exceeds the Bonferroni two-sided t critical value, p = 0.5
